title: The Musician from Brazil
text:
Carlos Mendes was born in 1950 in a small town in Brazil. He loved music from a young age. Every day after school, he played the guitar for hours.

When he was twenty, he moved to Rio de Janeiro to study music. There he wrote his first song. Today he is a famous singer, and he lives with his family in Lisbon.

options: In a small town in Brazil
In a big city in Portugal

options: He became a teacher in Lisbon

options: He was already a famous singer

questions.text: Why did Carlos probably move to Rio de Janeiro?
options: He wanted to become a professional musician
He wanted to leave music forever
He was tired of his family
He wanted to become a doctor

paragraph_translations: Carlos Mendes nasceu em 1950 em uma pequena cidade do Brasil. Ele amava música desde jovem. Todos os dias, depois da escola, tocava violão por horas.
Quando tinha vinte anos, mudou-se para o Rio de Janeiro para estudar música. Lá, escreveu sua primeira canção. Hoje ele é um cantor famoso e vive com a família em Lisboa.
